content: APPROVE. Independent evidence: build + clippy + fmt clean. 3/3 atproto_refresh tests pass: rotates_bundle_and_extends_expiry (DPoP-nonce-rotation retry path proven via MockFetcher 400-then-200 queue), unknown_token_returns_session_not_found, tampered_bundle_returns_crypto_error. proto_blue_oauth::OAuthSession::refresh() owns the DPoP-nonce dance internally — no hand-rolled JWT. Sealed bundle now carries (dpop_keypair_jwk_json + TokenSet); re-sealed atomically on refresh. SessionStore::ttl() accessor introduced for the Polaris-vs-AS-token-TTL decoupling. New AuthError::OauthRefreshFailed variant.
